title: 第1章 一蓑烟雨任平生第2章 你爹给你撑腰来了
slug: 杨戬你爹从朝歌城考编回来了

;;
灌江口杨家村，一个小小的院落里，一个精致可爱的小女孩坐在门口，小女孩穿着一件洗得发白的红袄，头发扎成两个麻花鞭子，不过也难掩那脸上的清气。
她呆呆的看着屋外的大雨，在女孩身边还站着一个美妇，一身月白色的素衣，将她玲珑身躯承托得恰到好处，她站在那里似乎让天地都失去了颜色，有一种说不出的灵艳。
那张精致的脸上却有一些忧愁，此刻她正看着院子里那棵被雨水压弯了的老槐树，不知道在想什么。
美妇把一件披肩披在了小女孩身上，道：“婵儿，回屋吧，别着了寒。”
小女孩并没有动，只是把脑袋往后靠了靠，靠在美妇膝盖上。
“阿娘，大哥，二哥去帮忙治水去了，阿爹在哪里啊。”
“爹爹在很远的地方。”
美妇声音里明显有一些幽怨，她蹲下身把女儿往怀里揽了揽，用自己的袖子擦去她脸上溅到的雨星。
“很远是多远？”
“比村东头二蛋家的田还远吗？”
小女孩回过头，仰着脸看她，那双眼睛黑亮亮的，像两颗刚洗过的葡萄。
美妇点了点头，轻轻的笑了笑。
她本是天庭的长公主瑶姬，也是天命的六天欲界之主，只因为二十多年前三首蛟龙作祟逃出了六天欲界，瑶姬为了阻止三首蛟龙为祸人间，于是下界追杀。
虽然那恶蛟最后伏诛了，可瑶姬也受了重伤，正好被路过的凡间男子杨易所救。
为了报答杨易，瑶姬便以身相许，而且还给他生了两个儿子一个女儿。
一家人在杨家村虽然日子过得很平淡，可瑶姬却很喜欢凡间的生活，可就在怀上第三胎的时候，一向温和的丈夫杨易不知道怎么了，竟然说要进京去谋一番前程。
杨易不顾她的反对，连教书先生也不当了，一个人就这么出了灌县。
这一走就是十年，瑶姬感觉这十年是她最难熬的日子，少了杨易在身边，这日子总感觉是空落落的。
最近灌江口的天气很不正常，已经接连下了半月的大雨，灌江口有很多地方决堤，这反常的天气让瑶姬意识到了，很有可能是天庭发现了自己与杨易结为夫妇的事。

天上的规矩十分森严，仙人不能与凡人通婚，这是天条，违逆天条，就算她是天庭的长公主，也要受到责罚，轻则打入天牢废去仙籍，严重一些甚至要上诛仙台。
“只怕不久之后天庭就会派来人马，杨易啊杨易，你到底去哪里了。”
她已经决定了独自面对这一切，可杨易这个家伙为了人间富贵，却错过了她最珍惜的时光。
“学堂上他们都说我是没爹的孩子，我跟他们说父亲是出去做大官去了，可他们根本不信。”
“等阿爹回来了，我一定要让阿爹为我主持公道，让他们看看我阿爹的威风。”
瑶姬无奈的一笑，这人间的官就算做得再大，也管不了天上的神仙，看着乖巧的杨婵，瑶姬一阵心疼，没有爹在身边，这孩子没有少受委屈。
如果有一天她不在了，她最放心不下的就是杨婵了。
“若有一天阿娘也像阿爹这样不在了，你要听两个哥哥的话，好好跟着两个大哥。”
“阿娘为什么会离开？阿娘不会离开的。”
“婵儿不是最喜欢天上的星星了么？阿娘要去给婵儿摘天上的星星，阿娘要把这世界上最好的东西给婵儿。”
“婵儿不要星星，阿爹和阿娘就是这世界上最好的东西了。”
雨打在院中的青石板上，噼里啪啦地响，瑶姬在杨婵旁边坐了下来，让杨婵的头靠在她的怀中。
“好好好，阿娘会一直陪着婵儿。”
“你给阿娘唱一首阿爹教的歌吧。”
“阿娘想听哪一首歌。”
“最拗口的那一首。”
“我知道了，是阿爹教给阿娘的那一首。”
杨婵清了清嗓子，开始唱了起来。
“喜欢你.....那双眼动人。”
杨婵的声音细细软软，咬字还不太清楚，她唱得很认真，小脑袋一点一点的晃着。

“喜欢你......那笑容更迷人......”
“愿再可......轻抚你......那可爱面容......”
瑶姬想起了初识杨易时候的场景，那个时候她最喜欢依偎杨易的怀中，静静的听他抚琴、唱歌。
雨依旧在噼里啪啦的下，瑶姬轻轻叹了一声，都说神仙岁月无痕，可这分离的十年，如天上百年，千年般难熬。

In Yangjia Village, Guanjiangkou, in a small courtyard, a delicate and cute little girl was sitting at the door. The little girl was wearing a red coat that had been washed white, and her hair was tied into two twisted whips, but she could not hide the freshness on her face.
She stared blankly at the heavy rain outside the house. Next to the girl stood a beautiful woman, dressed in moon-white plain clothes, which supported her exquisite body just right. She seemed to make the world lose its color as she stood there, with an indescribable aura.
There was some sadness on that delicate face. At this moment, she was looking at the old locust tree in the yard that was bent by the rain, and she didn't know what she was thinking.
The beautiful woman put a shawl on the little girl and said, "Chan'er, go back to the house, don't get cold."
The little girl didn't move, she just leaned her head back and rested on the beautiful woman's knees.
"Aniang, eldest brother, and second brother went to help control the flood. Where is daddy?"
"Daddy is far away."
There was obviously some resentment in the beautiful woman's voice. She knelt down and took her daughter into her arms, wiping the rain stars splashed on her face with her sleeves.
"How far is far?"
"Is it farther than the fields of Erdan's house in the east of the village?"
The little girl turned back and looked up at her. Her eyes were dark and bright, like two freshly washed grapes.
The beautiful woman nodded and smiled softly.
She was originally the eldest princess of heaven, Yao Ji, and the destined master of the Six Heavens Desire Realm. She escaped from the Six Heavens Desire Realm more than 20 years ago because of the troubles caused by three dragons. In order to prevent the three dragons from causing trouble to the world, Yao Ji was hunted down by the lower world.
Although the evil dragon was killed in the end, Yao Ji was also seriously injured and was saved by Yang Yi, a passing mortal man.
In order to repay Yang Yi, Yao Ji promised him her life and gave birth to two sons and a daughter.
Although the family lived a very ordinary life in Yangjia Village, Yao Ji liked the life in the mortal world very much. But when she was pregnant with her third child, her always gentle husband Yang Yi didn't know what happened and actually said that he wanted to go to Beijing to find a future.
Yang Yi ignored her objections and even refused to be a teacher, so he left Guan County alone.
It has been ten years since she left. Yao Ji feels that these ten years are the most difficult days for her. Without Yang Yi by her side, these days always feel empty.
The weather at Guanjiang estuary has been very abnormal recently. It has been raining for half a month continuously. Many places in Guanjiang estuary have burst their banks. This abnormal weather made Yao Ji realize that it was very likely that the heaven discovered that she and Yang Yi were married.
The rules in heaven are very strict. Immortals cannot marry mortals. This is a rule of heaven. If she violates the rules of heaven, even if she is the eldest princess of heaven, she will be punished. At the least, she will be thrown into the heavenly prison and her immortal status will be revoked. In more serious cases, she will even be sent to the execution platform.
"I'm afraid that Heavenly Court will send troops soon. Yang Yi, Yang Yi, where have you been?"
She had decided to face all this alone, but this guy Yang Yi missed her most cherished time for the sake of wealth in the world.
"They all said in school that I was a child without a father. I told them that my father had gone out to become a high official, but they didn't believe it at all."
"When my father comes back, I must let him uphold justice for me and let them see my father's majesty."
Yao Ji smiled helplessly, no matter how big the official in the world was, he could not control the gods in the sky. Looking at the well-behaved Yang Chan, Yao Ji felt heartbroken. Without her father by her side, the child was not less wronged.
If one day she is gone, the person she will worry about the most is Yang Chan.
"If one day grandma is gone like daddy, you have to listen to your two elder brothers and follow them well."
"Why did Aniang leave? Aniang will not leave."
"Don't Chan'er like the stars in the sky the most? My mother-in-law is going to pick the stars in the sky for Chan'er. My mother-in-law wants to give the best things in the world to Chan'er."
"Chan'er doesn't want stars, so dad and mom willIt's the best thing in the world. "
The rain hit the bluestone in the courtyard, making a crackling sound. Yao Ji sat down next to Yang Chan and let Yang Chan's head rest in her arms.
"Okay, okay, grandma will always stay with Chan'er. "
"Sing a song to my mother-in-law that my father taught me. "
"Which song does Grandma want to listen to? "
"The most awkward one. "
"I know, it's the song that my father taught my mother-in-law. "
Yang Chan cleared her throat and started singing.
"I like you... those eyes are moving. "
Yang Chan's voice was thin and soft, and her articulation was not very clear. She sang very seriously, her little head shaking little by little.
"I like you...that smile is even more charming..."
"I wish I could... caress your... lovely face..."
Yao Ji recalled the scene when she first met Yang Yi. At that time, she loved to cuddle up in Yang Yi's arms and listen to him playing the piano and singing quietly.
The rain was still pattering, and Yao Ji sighed softly. It is said that the immortals have no trace of time, but these ten years of separation are as difficult as a hundred years or a thousand years in the sky.
